what: Walk east along the z=16 ford into unwritten (1,0); wait for the witness (up to 240 s); read the chunk: name, residents, props, words, lore, errand; the names in use it was given

actions.eval: (async () => { const S = await import('/state/index.ts'); return JSON.stringify({ chunk: S.useEngineStore.getState().chunk, c10: S.useLandStore.getState().chunks['1,0']?.status ?? 'absent' }) })()
